items.title: Lifecycle risk management system
items.objective: Assess documented lifecycle identification, treatment and reassessment of risks.

procedures.text: Trace sampled risks through identification, mitigation, testing and residual-risk acceptance.
Challenge misuse, vulnerable-group harms, interactions and completeness with domain specialists.
Reconcile material risks to predefined metrics, thresholds and versioned validation evidence.
Inspect monitoring/incident-driven risk updates and accountability.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Quality management and governance
items.objective: Assess relevant accountable governance and quality management processes.

procedures.text: Inspect documented responsibilities, approvals, design/change controls and quality processes.
Sample control operation, supplier management, training and escalations.
Reconcile governance procedures to actual product releases and risk decisions.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Specific transparency obligations
items.objective: Assess applicable transparency duties separately from high-risk routing.

procedures.text: Assess provider/deployer and use-based transparency applicability and transitions.
Inspect notices, content labeling/detection solutions or other required measures within scope.
Observe user-facing behavior and approved exceptions with legal rationale.
